web.description:
He later took on the role of [vampire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vampire) [Louis de Pointe du Lac](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis_de_Pointe_du_Lac) in the horror drama _[Interview with the Vampire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Interview_with_the_Vampire_(film))_ (1994) and for his performance in the epic drama _[Legends of the Fall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Legends_of_the_Fall)_ (1994), he earned his first [Golden Globe Award for Best Actor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Actor_%E2%80%93_Motion_Picture_Drama) nomination.

[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brad_Pitt_filmography#cite_note-WinterHughes2007-5) His performance as a psychotic mental patient in the science fiction film _[12 Monkeys](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/12_Monkeys)_ won him the [Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Supporting_Actor_%E2%80%93_Motion_Picture) and an Academy Award nomination in [the same category](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Supporting_Actor). [[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brad_Pitt_filmography#cite_note-8) Pitt reteamed with Fincher to star in the apocalyptic film _[Fight Club](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fight_Club)_ (1999) as anti-consumerist cult leader [Tyler Durden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tyler_Durden), a role that required him to learn [boxing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boxing), [taekwondo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taekwondo), and [grappling](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grappling).

[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brad_Pitt_filmography#cite_note-21) For playing a stunt double to [Leonardo DiCaprio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leonardo_DiCaprio)'s character in [Quentin Tarantino](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quentin_Tarantino)'s film _[Once Upon a Time in Hollywood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Once_Upon_a_Time_in_Hollywood)_ (2019), he won an [Academy Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Supporting_Actor), a [Golden Globe Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Globe_Award_for_Best_Supporting_Actor_%E2%80%93_Motion_Picture), and a [BAFTA Award for Best Actor in a Supporting Role](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BAFTA_Award_for_Best_Actor_in_a_Supporting_Role).
